answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 49009 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: Division of Property for a person having only sister and nephew Question: My friend's uncle died leaving behind only a real sister and a nephew (son of real brother). He has no other living relatives (wife, kids, etc.). I wish to inquire as to the division of his property, in light of the above. Kindly guide at your earliest and oblige. Answer ID: 49009 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1675/1341/B=12/1434) In the case mentioned above, his daughter will be eligible to receive half of all his property, while his nephew will receive the remaining part for to being ‘asba. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
